meta.description: Placeholder file documenting the Hinges__ subfolder for the Interior Door Configurator. No live consumer reads from this folder yet; hinge geometry will be added in a future iteration once panel rebates and beading are implemented. The schema for hinge JSONs will follow the same unified asset format used by Handles__ (Na__Asset__Metadata + Na__Asset__Plan2D + Na__Asset__Elevation2D + Na__Asset__Mesh3D).
meta.namingConvention: All custom keys prefixed Na__. Three-stage form Na__Section__SubSection__FieldName.

fieldPrefixes.Na__Asset__: Top-level asset metadata and content blocks (see Handles__ for live example)

Na__Asset__Metadata.Na__Asset__Description: This folder is reserved for future hinge asset JSONs (e.g. butt hinges, concealed hinges) authored using the unified 2D + 3D + metadata format. Files starting with an underscore are ignored by the AssetLibrary scanner.
Na__Asset__Metadata.Na__Asset__Notes: When adding the first real hinge asset, follow the naming pattern Na__InteriorDoor__Hinge__<HingeKey>__.json and reuse the structure of Na__InteriorDoor__Handle__Default__.json.
